posts.name: phantaskippy
posts.cooked:
If I post a fan deck here, and then Christopher puts out one of his own decks and they have mechanics in common I could sue GtG, which wastes their time and energy.

Their lawyers advised them to not allow it, and they also will not look at fan decks we make, like you can't go to a convention and talk to Christopher about your deck idea, he won't listen.

Just keeps them from creating an openning to get sued.
